artboards.title: The Storefront · with the sounder and the Troughs
Home · the trough in the yard
Home · the sheet, past your quarter

annotations.text: The store — C with B folded in. The Trough is a wooden trough by the counter holding the sounder's open drives as notched rows; friends who bought today stand at the counter wearing it; Closet and Furnish hang as signs by the chalkboard. Same states, same sheet on tap.

Home, steady — while a sounder Trough is open, a small trough sits in the yard beside the mound (the mound's rule: things in the yard, never actions). Slop level = the leading drive; notches light as quarters pass; a tap unfolds one tag, and the tag opens the sheet.
Home, fanned — “Trough” joins Dig · Barn · Bury a truffle with a hand line naming the leading drive. Armable like the rest; the face can wear it.

The sheet, just after a chip pushed Sam's Top Hat past the third notch: the receipt line says what fell, the toast on the app-wide line says the bank (19 → 21). The amount is random inside a server-tuned range and never quoted before it lands.

Tokens from constants/theme.ts; Home anatomy from docs/design/claude-design/barn/barn-home.html (the ratified comp); Trough copy from components/TroughSection.tsx; fan rows from components/Barn.tsx. The shopkeep is placeholder art (Pepper with a tape note). Friend names and drive numbers are sample data.

Working files: docs/design/claude-design/shop-2026-09-16/
A · Drop First — "the drop is the shop; everything else is a door." Not chosen.
B · The Neighbors' Shop — "see what your sounder wears; buy it, or chip in for theirs." Not chosen as a whole; its Troughs-as-cards and sounder strip were folded into C.
C · The Storefront — the round-one sketch, before the sounder and the Troughs moved into the scene. Chosen 2026-09-16.
